proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node (FAQ/accordion answer text, sometimes with its own nested sub-list) appears as a sibling of the page's main content sections instead of nested inside its accordion question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-attach the region's text/sub-list to the matching accordion row as its answer during Phase 2; never emit it as its own section or block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The capture promotes absolutely-positioned accordion answer panels out of their DOM parent, here escaping two levels (rc2c9, rc2c10) to sit alongside the CTA section.
